name: Is Finansal Kiralama Anonim Sirketi
summary: Is Finansal Kiralama Anonim Sirketi engages in financial leasing services in Turkey and internationally. The company's leasing products include sale and lease back, software leasing, leasing abroad, leasing in free zones, and operational leasing. The company is also involved in leasing of construction and business machinery, renewable energy projects, passenger and commercial vehicles, production machines, agricultural machinery, medical devices, real estate, air and sea transportation vehicles, and others.
